declared_limits: VCA plus Tamura mass disorder; no short-range order, no local force-constant change
gray diffuse boundary with one length; real grain size distributions and interface roughness spectra are not modelled
dopants scatter phonons only by mass and size; electron-phonon scattering at 1e20 cm^-3 and dopant precipitation are out of scope
strain term for B, P, C is bracketed (eps 0 to 39), not computed; a MACE local-relaxation gate is the named follow-up to narrow it
RTA; pure Si and Ge RTA underestimates full BTE by about 4-12% (party 4a), alloys by about 1.5%
no electronic thermal conductivity, so comparisons with measured total kappa are one-sided bounds

deliverables.D1: kappa_L(x, d, T) table plus a compact law with declared validity domain
deliverables.D2: Ge-savings frontier: minimum x reaching kappa_L <= 2.5 and <= 4.0 W/mK at 300 K and 1100 K, as a function of grain size
deliverables.D3: dopant lever table: percent change of kappa_L for B, P, C vs n, x, d, both eps bounds
deliverables.D4: screening decision: (x, d >= 10 nm) minimising kappa_L at 300 K and at 1100 K

deviation_policy: infrastructure reruns allowed with a ledger deviation entry; any change to gates, grid, constants or predictions after registration is a new pre-registration, not an edit

gates_N0.G1_postprocessor: per-mode RTA bulk kappa reproduces kappa_Tsweep RTA within 0.5% at every (x, T) where party-4a Tsweep output exists (x in {0,0.15,0.2,0.5,0.7,0.85,1}, T in {300,700,1100})
gates_N0.G2_tamura_implementation: Tamura post-processor applied to the pure-Si modes at 300 K with the x=0.2 VCA mass variance (g = sum f_i (1 - M_i/Mbar)^2) gives kappa within a factor 1.5 of almaBTE's own VCA x=0.2 kappa (different dispersions, so a sanity bound only)
gates_N0.G3_boundary_limits: kappa(d) strictly decreasing in d-> smaller; kappa(10 um) within 30% of bulk for alloys; pure Si kappa(5 nm) < 25% of bulk
gates_N0.on_failure: record gate_failure on the ledger; no N1 result is reported as a finding

grid.grain_size_nm: log-spaced 5 nm to 10 um, 25 points, plus bulk (no boundary term)

operator_go: issue 55, 2026-09-29: 'go for Nanostructured SiGe and light doping'

physics_constants.host_mass_and_radius: Vegard average of Si and Ge (the VCA host)

predictions.Pr1: x=0.2, 300 K, d=20 nm, undoped: kappa_L in [2, 5] W/mK
predictions.Pr2: nanostructuring suppression kappa(20 nm)/kappa_bulk at 300 K is smaller (stronger) at x=0.2 than at x=0.5
predictions.Pr3: light doping is a weak lever in the alloy: for x in [0.15, 0.85] and n <= 1e20 cm^-3, B or P lowers kappa_L by less than 10% at every d under the mass-only bound (eps=0)
predictions.Pr4: boundary and dopant scattering show diminishing returns: synergy S = kappa_both*kappa_bulk/(kappa_dop*kappa_gb) >= 1 at x=0.2, 300 K, d=20 nm, B 1e20
predictions.Pr5: open-data check (N3): the effective grain size inferred from each Starrydata sintered/nanostructured Si-rich (x in [0.15,0.25]) 300 K curve, treating total kappa as an upper bound on kappa_L, has a median in [10, 300] nm

question: Which grain size and composition window minimises the lattice thermal conductivity of a SiGe thermoelectric leg, how much germanium can nanostructuring save, and is light doping (B, P, C) a useful extra thermal lever on top of alloying and grain boundaries?

tool.solver: RTA per-mode re-summation of phononinfo output
